readme:
# Inside Higher Ed Careers Scraper Scrape job listings from Inside Higher Ed Careers ([careers.insidehighered.com](https://careers.insidehighered.com/)), the US job board for faculty, administrative and executive positions at colleges and universities and for jobs outside higher education. You get the title, employer, location, salary text with parsed amounts when the advertiser states them, and the New and Featured badges for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full description, the exact posting and closing time, the employer page, the recruiter type, the apply method, categories and institution types. Search by keyword and the site's own filters (faculty, administrative, executive and outside-higher-ed areas, position type, institution type, location, employer type, employment type), or start from any jobs address of the site. ## What you get - One row per job, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, in USD) when the salary text states amounts. - Optional job page details: exact posting and closing time, full description as HTML and plain text, employer page, recruiter type, apply method, reference, categories and institution types. These columns are filled only with the job page option on (detail-only columns). - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. Sponsored top job cards that the site may show above a filtered list are not part of the results and are skipped. - A run with an input that has none of the fields below returns 5 jobs for the keyword director. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/insidehighered-careers-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `insidehighered-careers-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "director" (director roles at universities). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "director" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as director, professor, registrar or data analyst. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to read the newest jobs. | | `startUrls` | Addresses on careers.insidehighered.com: `https://careers.insidehighered.com/jobs/` or `https://careers.insidehighered.com/jobs/adjunct/california/?Keywords=biology`. The filter slugs, the Keywords parameter and `sort=Date` are kept. A `/searchjobs/` address with only Keywords is read as `/jobs/?Keywords=...`. Reading starts at page 1. Paths that the site's robots.txt disallows are rejected with a message in the run status. | | `sortBy` | `relevance` (default) or `date` (newest first). | | `facultyJobs` | Faculty Jobs: `arts-and-humanities`, `education`, `engineering-and-mathematics`, `health-and-medical`, `professional-fields`, `science-and-technology`, `social-sciences`, `technical-and-vocational-fields`. | | `administrativeJobs` | Administrative Jobs: `academic-affairs`, `institutional-and-business-affairs`, `technology`, `student-affairs`. | | `executiveJobs` | Executive Administration Jobs: `c-level-and-executive-directors`, `deans`, `other-executive-administration`, `presidents-and-chancellors`, `provosts`, `vice-presidents`. | | `outsideHigherEdJobs` | Jobs Outside Higher Education: `businesses-and-consultants`, `government-agencies`, `museums-and-cultural-organizations`, `non-profit-organizations-and-associations`, `publishers-and-presses`, `other-jobs-outside-higher-education`, `research-and-development`. | | `positionTypes` | Position Type: `assistant-professor`, `tenured-and-tenure-track`, `adjunct`, `postdoc`, `alt-ac-and-post-ac`. | | `institutionTypes` | Institution Type: `community-college`, `four-year-institution`, `outside-academe`, `for-profit`, `specialized-institutions`, `other-organizations`. | | `locations` | Location: `california`, `florida`, `georgia`, `illinois`, `maryland`, `north-carolina`, `ohio`, `pennsylvania`, `texas`, `north-america`. | | `employerTypes` | Employer Type: `employer`, `search-firm`, `advertising-agency`. | | `employmentTypes` | Employment Type: `full-time`, `part-time`. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword or start URL. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. Same price. | The filters are the path slugs of the site's browse list, for example `/jobs/adjunct/california/?Keywords=biology`. The fields take free text: a value is lower-cased, spaces become `-`, `&` becomes `and`, and only letters, digits and `-` are kept. The slugs above are the ones the site lists in its "Refine your search" block; others may work. Filters are put into the path in the order of the table above (the four area groups first). One search runs per keyword and per combination of one value from each filter you fill (at most 60 searches per run). When all values of a filter are unusable, the run reads nothing and ends with 0 jobs. Examples: ```json { "searchQueries": ["biology"], "positionTypes": ["adjunct"], "locations": ["california"], "maxResults": 30 } ``` ```json { "facultyJobs": ["science-and-technology"], "employmentTypes": ["full-time"], "sortBy": "date" } ``` ## Sample output ```json { "id": "3561079", "title": "Executive Director", "slug": "executive-director", "company": "Metro Deaf School", "company_id": "21eb1e5c-4165-4601-a6d5-2e5bc3e382b4", "company_url": "https://careers.insidehighered.com/employer/21eb1e5c-4165-4601-a6d5-2e5bc3e382b4/metro-deaf-school", "company_logo": "https://careers.insidehighered.com/getasset/87e3fecc-a718-4339-8175-c2486d209b87/", "location": "Saint Paul, Minnesota", "city": "Saint Paul", "region": "Minnesota", "country_code": "US", "location_terms": [ "Ramsey County", "Minnesota", "United States", "North America", "Saint Paul" ], "salary_text": "$110,000-$160,000", "salary_min": 110000, "salary_max": 160000, "salary_period": null, "salary_currency": "USD", "description_short": "The Executive Director serves as the chief executive and educational leader of the school...", "description_html": "

The Executive Director serves as the chief executive and educational leader of the school...

", "description_text": "The Executive Director serves as the chief executive and educational leader of the school...", "date_posted": "2026-10-09T15:26:00.000Z", "valid_through": "2026-11-28T04:59:00.000Z", "is_new": true, "is_featured": false, "recruiter_id": "3504497", "recruiter_type": "Employer", "application_method": "Email", "listing_type": "Job Posting", "direct_apply": true, "reference": "https://www.mdsmn.org/join-us/employment", "employment_codes": [ "OTHER" ], "categories": [ "C-Level & Executive Directors" ], "institution_types": [ "Other Organizations" ], "job_url": "https://careers.insidehighered.com/job/3561079/executive-director/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "director", "source": "careers.insidehighered.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric job id: the number in the job address /job///. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the listing. | | `slug` | string, null | Text part of the job address. | | `company` | string, null | Employer name as shown on the listing. | | `company_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Id of the employer page (the uuid in /employer//). | | `company_url` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employer profile page on Inside Higher Ed Careers. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the employer, when the listing card shows one. | | `location` | string, null | Location text as shown on the listing. | | `city` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Town from the job posting data. | | `region` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). State or region from the job posting data. | | `country_code` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Country code from the job posting data. | | `location_terms` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Location hierarchy terms of the job, from the town up to the continent. Empty when the page has none. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as typed by the advertiser, for example '$110,000-$160,000'. Not every listing states one. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound in USD, read from the salary text when it states amounts. Null otherwise. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound in USD, read from a range or from 'up to X'. Null otherwise. | | `salary_period` | string, null | year, hour, day, week or month when the text names a period, else null. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | Currency code of the amounts (USD unless the text names another), else null. | | `description_short` | string, null | Teaser text of the listing card. | | `description_html` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as HTML. | | `description_text` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as plain text. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Exact posting time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Closing time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `is_new` | boolean | True when the card carries the 'New' badge. | | `is_featured` | boolean | True when the card is a top job, showcase, premium or upsell listing. | | `recruiter_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Internal id of the employer account, as given in the page data. | | `recruiter_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Type of the poster, for example Employer. | | `application_method` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). How applications are taken, for example Email or ExternalRedirect. | | `listing_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Listing product of the job, for example Job Posting. | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). directApply flag of the job posting data. | | `reference` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Advertiser reference of the job posting data: the employer's own job number or application address. | | `employment_codes` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employment types from the job posting data (FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, OTHER, ...). Empty when none. | | `categories` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). The area categories the site files the job under (the labels of Faculty Jobs, Administrative Jobs, Executive Administration Jobs, Jobs Outside Higher Education). Empty when none. | | `institution_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Institution type labels of the job page. Empty when none. | | `job_url` | string | Job page on Inside Higher Ed Careers. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword, start URL or 'all jobs' that found the job. | | `source` | string | Source host. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was built, ISO 8601 (UTC). | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. The job page option is included in the same price. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [HigherEdJobs Scraper: Academic, Faculty & University Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/higheredjobs-scraper): US higher education jobs from HigherEdJobs. - [Jobs.ac.uk Scraper - UK Academic & PhD Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobs-ac-uk-scraper): Academic jobs in the UK from jobs.ac.uk. - [EURAXESS Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/euraxess-scraper): Research and academic jobs across Europe from EURAXESS. - [Idealist Nonprofit Jobs Scraper: Salaries & Organizations](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/idealist-scraper): Nonprofit and mission-driven jobs from Idealist. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one search return?** The list shows 20 jobs per page. The actor reads page after page until the site's "Found N jobs" count is reached, the last page is reached, or your limit is reached. The site holds about 23,000 jobs in total. **Why are some cards skipped?** The site can show a sponsored carousel of jobs above a filtered list that ignores the filters. Those cards are not results of your search and are skipped. Cards styled as featured that belong to the result list are kept, and `is_featured` marks them. **Why is the salary parsed for only some jobs?** Advertisers type the salary freely. Texts such as "Competitive" or "Commensurate with experience" are returned as `salary_text` only. The numbers `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_period` and `salary_currency` are filled when the text states amounts, for example "$110,000-$160,000", "$70,000 - $85,000 per year" or "Minimum $75,000". **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged for jobs. **What if the site blocks a page?** The site's firewall sometimes answers with an "Error 403" page. The actor retries the page a few times and then once more by another route. If a job page still cannot be read, the row is delivered with its list fields only and the run status says how many job pages were missed. If list pages cannot be read at all, the run ends with a clear "Blocked" status. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/insidehighered-careers-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
